scoring_justification: Band gap compared with tolerance; Eu 4f vs U linear trend recomputed via linear fit on agent's CSV (monotonicity and R²), no reliance on agent-reported metric.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference band gap value (6.7 eV) from paper's calculated result.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: calculated DOS increase at 6.7 eV, agrees with experimental 7.1 eV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected U values and linear trend check parameters for Eu 4f vs U.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper section 3.3 and Fig. 3; U range 4.35-7.62 eV, J=0.68 eV with linear dependence and decreasing Energy_to_VBM.
hidden_assets.generation_method: U values from paper; reference solve.sh provides exact gold numbers that reproduce the paper's trend.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Derived from paper's described conditions and confirmed against oracle solve.sh.

schema.description: A single floating-point number representing the calculated band gap in eV.

outputs.description: The GGA-computed band gap of pure Sr2MgSi2O7. Compared to a hidden reference value with tolerance.

CSV file mapping Hubbard U to the energy of the occupied Eu2+ 4f ground state relative to the valence band maximum (VBM) and conduction band minimum (CBM). The linear trend and slope are recomputed and compared to a hidden reference.

output_contract.notes: Band gap compared to a hidden reference value; CSV checked for monotonic trend of Energy_to_VBM with U and slope compared to hidden reference.
